request.description:
**Requirement:** API Standard (Confluence 524593) & SEC-M01 Auth Stripping — Protected Traveler mutation endpoints must fail closed when Bearer authentication is missing.

**OWASP Mapping:** OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control (CWE-284) & A07:2025 Authentication Failures (CWE-306) · OWASP API2:2023

**Single-Variable Delta:** Omit ONLY Authorization Bearer header on PUT /api/traveler/update-profile

**Expected Response:** API fails closed with 4xx authentication/authorization error (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>, never 2xx or 500).

**Expected Data Result (Readback):** Zero profile records modified; GET /api/traveler/me readback matches pre-test state.

request.description:
**Requirement:** API Standard (Confluence 524593) & SEC-M02 Cross-Actor BOLA — Traveler A must never modify stayingGuests on a Customer Request owned by Traveler B.

**OWASP Mapping:** OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control (CWE-283 Unverified Ownership, CWE-639) · OWASP API1:2023 BOLA

**Single-Variable Delta:** Replace ONLY path parameter :customerRequestId with Traveler B's {{foreignCustomerRequestId}} while authenticated as Traveler A

**Expected Response:** API rejects cross-account object access (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>, HTTP 403 or 404 Fail-Closed).

**Expected Data Result (Readback):** Traveler B's Customer Request stayingGuests record remains 100% unchanged on GET readback.

request.description:
**Requirement:** OpenAPI Governance (Confluence 144015744) & SEC-M04 Mass Assignment — Undeclared privilege fields ('role') in profile update payload must never elevate user privileges.

**OWASP Mapping:** OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control & A08:2025 Software or Data Integrity Failures (CWE-915) · OWASP API3:2023 BOPLA

**Single-Variable Delta:** Add ONLY undeclared privilege property role='admin' to valid-update-profile.json

**Expected Response:** API either rejects unknown field with 400 (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>) or strips undeclared property per DTO allow-list.

**Expected Data Result (Readback):** No privilege escalation created or persisted; GET /api/traveler/me readback confirms Traveler role is unchanged.

**Requirement:** OP-1951 Contract Verification & SEC-M08 Cost-Endpoint & CORS Gate — Third-party OpenAI endpoints must enforce auth/quota and never reflect untrusted CORS Origins with credentials.

**OWASP Mapping:** OWASP A02:2025 Security Misconfiguration (CWE-942) & X01:2025 Lack of Resilience (CWE-400) · OWASP API4:2023 & API8:2023

**Single-Variable Delta:** Omit Authorization header and pass untrusted Origin https://untrusted-origin.example.test

**Expected Response:** Rejected per confirmed auth policy (<CHECK_OPENAPI> / <CHECK_ERROR_REGISTRY>) and Access-Control-Allow-Origin does not reflect https://untrusted-origin.example.test.

**Expected Data Result (Readback):** Zero unauthorized OpenAI translation quota consumed; no database state mutated.
